title: The Fortune Machine Said SATURDAY
premise: The county fair's fortune machine is never wrong, and my card says I'll break my Uncle Ray's heart on Saturday, so I dodge him all week.
twist: Saturday was the day Ray meant to hand me his hot dog cart, so my hiding is what broke his heart; his own rule, nothing broken stays broken past breakfast, brings him to my door on Sunday at dawn with two egg sandwiches and the second apron.
world: A bright county fair midway with striped tents, a stopped big wheel, Uncle Ray's red and white hot dog cart with a striped umbrella, a tall teal fortune machine with a painted gold star, and our house with its porch.
